summary: Iter 3 testing — TikTok Shop buttons + Smart Upsell Modal. Backend 2/2 PASS. Frontend: toko+tiktok links on all 3 cards with correct hrefs, upsell modal opens ~700ms after add-to-cart, discounted price 179100 vs 199000 shown for rotifer→TBN upsell and 116999 vs 129999 for TBN→rotifer upsell, upsell-accept/decline/close all working, cart drawer shows bundle line, pixels (fbq+ttq) loaded, order regression intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Intentional v1 quirk (already documented): when user already has the upsell target in cart, cart.add() merges by product_id and discards bundle price + '(Bundle -10%)' name silently. Consider using a distinct id like `${target.id}-bundle` for a cleaner UX, or show a toast explaining the merge.
tiktok_shop_url values are search placeholders (https://www.tiktok.com/search?q=...) — replace with actual TikTok Shop deep-links before prod.
Bundle discount is client-side only; backend /api/orders recomputes price from product_id so orders always use base price. Acceptable for v1 and documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 3 adds UpsellModal + TikTok Shop buttons. Backend exposes tiktok_shop_url + upsell_target on each product. Upsell triggers 700ms after add-to-cart. Bundle line uses same product_id → merges if target already in cart (documented). test_v3_upsell.py covers new backend fields + order regression.
